source.snippet: Is it just me, or has Opus suddenly turned dumb as rocks with 0 attention span over the last half day or so? Noticeably worse output across multiple agents on very different projects. (26 points, 22 comments)

problem_statement: Developers running production AI agent pipelines have no reliable way to detect or be alerted when an LLM provider silently degrades model quality, causing costly downstream failures before they notice.
target_segment: Software developers and AI engineers running multi-agent or agentic workflows on top of third-party LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) at small-to-mid-size companies.
notes: 26 upvotes and 22 comments suggest broad resonance. Teams paying for LLM API usage (direct cost) suffer silent quality regressions with no notification from providers. A monitoring/canary service that continuously probes model quality and alerts paying customers would have clear willingness-to-pay — these are engineering teams already spending on API credits.
